E4Plus1.uk.description: The TV shows include Big Brother: The Launch, Don't Look Down for SU2C, Antiques Roadshow, Coronation Street, Big Little Journeys and Beat the Chasers Celebrity Special. (S22 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jessica, who's 28, is a real-life Bridget Jones who wants the perfect man to bring out her naughty side. Opera singer Clare, who's 21, seeks someone who hits all the right notes. (S7 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Dating Naked UK
E4Plus1.uk.description: Cocktails & C*** Tales: Two singles go on a tandem bike riding double date with two newbies. And a huge twist at the dumping ground sends everyone into a spin. (S1 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box this time: Strictly Come Dancing, Sex Education, Blankety Blank, Bake Off, Celebrity Race Across the World, Love & Death, Celebrity SAS: Who Dares Wins, and Ambulance. (S22 Ep4) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Captain Sandy has quite the dilemma on her hands with two hapless deckhands. And a demanding guest wants to go for a risky late-night swim. (S10 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Prohibition Grille: Gordon visits the Prohibition Grille in Washington State, where restaurateur Rishi is oblivious to the disastrous dishes being made in her own kitchen. (S6 Ep14) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Goldberg Thanksgiving: Beverly challenges Erica to participate in Jazzercise after Erica says her mum's obsession is sad. Marvin visits the family at Thanksgiving. (S2 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: I Rode a Hoverboard: Adam breaks his arm and tells his friends that he fell off a hoverboard, just like Marty McFly in Back to the Future. (S2 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
E4Plus1.uk.description: Craig's grand plan for his wedding to Sofia was to combine his two great loves: her and beer. So what did Sofia think of her Oktoberfest-themed wedding?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mother Tucker: Cameron loves his mum, so Mitchell isn't sure how to tell Cam that she makes him uncomfortable. When Haley breaks up with Dylan, Phil takes it harder than anyone. (S2 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dance Dance Revelation: Everyone gets in on the fun at Luke and Manny's first school dance. A trip to the mall with the boys becomes stressful for Jay and Phil. (S2 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: Essex and east London. Spencer and Sara serve a simple Jewish feast. Lauren and Jack's menu reflects their South African and Burmese heritage. Paul and Ed's food challenges a picky palate.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Juniper Hill Inn (Part 1/2): Gordon visits the historic Juniper Hill Inn in Vermont, which looks like a million dollars but smells of sewage... (S1 Ep3) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Juniper Hill Inn (Part 2/2): The issues keep coming at the Juniper Hill Inn in Vermont. Can Gordon help the staff and owners to communicate? Or will he be forced to abandon ship? (S1 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Captain Sandy has quite the dilemma on her hands with two hapless deckhands. And a demanding guest wants to go for a risky late-night swim. (S10 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Cover-Up: Phil has a new client who is also 'his type'. Afraid that might get him into trouble with Claire, he tells some seemingly innocent lies, which lead to more lies... (S7 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Express Yourself: Phil has the crazy idea of going on a spontaneous trip to Paris with Claire. And Jay takes over their bathroom renovation. (S7 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Walking Big & Tall: Marge urges Homer to lose weight. Instead, he finds a support group that encourages him to embrace his size. Lisa writes an anthem for Springfield. (S26 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Princess Guide: Homer chaperones a Nigerian princess while her father negotiates a uranium deal with Mr Burns. He takes her to Moe's bar, where Moe begins to fall for her. (S26 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sky Police: Chief Wiggum uses a military jet pack to fight crime. But when he crashes into the church, Marge and the congregation resort to gambling to pay for the repairs. (S26 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Peeping Mom: Bart lies to cover up his role in a bulldozer crash, so Marge decides to follow him everywhere until he confesses. Ned's cute new dog loves Homer. (S26 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boyle-Linetti Wedding: The squad are all given tasks to complete for Gina's mum's wedding to Boyle's dad. (S2 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Captain Peralta: Peralta's father, an airline pilot who hasn't played a big part in his life, comes to town. Holt sets the squad an impossible brain teaser. (S2 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Finding Fizbo: Cam is enraged when he sees a clip of someone desecrating his beloved Fizbo costume, so he sets out on a quest to restore Fizbo's good name. (S8 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Basketball!: Phil's been doing basketball training so that he can redeem himself at the annual charity game. Then NBA stars Charles Barkley and DeAndre Jordan turn up... (S8 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pig Moon Rising: Mitchell accidentally knocks over an urn filled with Cam's beloved pet pig Lilly's ashes. Can he cover up his blunder? (S8 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Five Minutes: Mitch and Cam have five minutes to catch a flight, and Haley and Rainer are forced to re-evaluate their entire relationship in five minutes. (S8 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gal of Constant Sorrow: Bart and Lisa get to know a homeless folk singer. Homer's attempt at DIY traps the cat in the walls of the house, so he launches a rescue bid. (S27 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa the Veterinarian: Lisa is inspired to become a vet and begins an internship at a local surgery. Marge gets a job as a crime scene cleaner but finds it traumatic. (S27 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Marge-ian Chronicles: When Lisa signs up to participate in the future colonisation of Mars, Marge's attempt to use reverse psychology to discourage her goes badly wrong. (S27 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burns Cage: Homer makes it his mission to find romance for Smithers. Milhouse is jealous of Lisa's leading man when she's cast in the school production of Casablanca. (S27 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Wandering Juvie: After Bart scams the town out of wedding presents, he is sent to juvenile detention. But he ends up on the run, chained to a female inmate. (S15 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Tree Grows in Springfield: Homer becomes addicted to a tablet that Lisa wins for him in the school's silent auction, but he's distraught when it gets broken. (S24 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: A huge change in the crew rocks the boat. A flirty love triangle heats up. And chef Josh struggles to cater to some very particular vegan guests. (S10 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Protocol: (2011) Part four of the Tom Cruise action-thriller franchise. The Impossible Missions Force fight to clear their name, while also trying to avert nuclear war. Busy, busy, busy!
